parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text description of the material to generate, for example weathered copper patina or mossy stone wall.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: An optional starting texture. Without a mask, PATINA creates variations. With a mask, it inpaints the marked region.

parameters.name: imageStrength
parameters.description: How much to transform the input image. Higher values change it more. Only used when an image is provided.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: A black-and-white mask for inpainting. White regions are regenerated, black regions are preserved. Requires an input image.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels. Upscaling applies to PBR maps only, not the base texture.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels. Upscaling applies to PBR maps only, not the base texture.

parameters.name: maps
parameters.description: Which PBR maps to predict. Deselect all to skip PBR estimation and only generate the texture.
parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value — a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: upscaleFactor
parameters.description: Seamless upscale for predicted PBR maps. 0 keeps map resolution, 2 doubles it, 4 quadruples it (up to 8K from a 2048 texture). The base texture is not upscaled.

parameters.name: tilingMode
parameters.description: Which directions the material repeats seamlessly. Both repeats in every direction; Horizontal repeats left-to-right; Vertical repeats top-to-bottom.

parameters.name: numOutputs
parameters.description: Number of texture images to generate from the same prompt.

parameters.name: numInferenceSteps
parameters.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation. Higher values take longer.

parameters.name: enablePromptExpansion
parameters.description: Expand the prompt with an LLM for richer material detail.

parameters.name: tileSize
parameters.description: Seamless-tiling window in latent space. 64 ≈ 512px, 128 ≈ 1024px, 256 ≈ 2048px. Match this to the output resolution for cleaner repeats.

parameters.name: tileStride
parameters.description: How far the tiling window steps between passes. Smaller than tile size adds overlap and usually smoother seams; larger is faster but can show a grid.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: A number that makes results repeatable. Reusing the same seed and settings produces the same material; leave it empty for a different result each time.

next_step.instructions: Optional: prompt_spark rewrites a short or underspecified prompt into an on-model one — pass your draft or the user intent as prompt (model_id is required), then use its recommended_call.parameters as the model_run parameters, as-is or edited. Skip it when the user wants their exact prompt used verbatim.
